name: shell_probe
description: Run a command and answer from its output. `run` is 55% of real tool calls, so this is the busiest path in the harness.
prompt: Run ./check.sh and report the failing case it prints.

files.check.sh:
#!/bin/sh
echo 'FAIL: cache_hit expected 42 got None'
echo 'ran 3 cases'
exit 1

respond.content: check.sh reports FAIL: cache_hit expected 42 got None (exit 1).
